admission.title: Admission Information
admission.overview: Admissions are conducted through the university's online admission portal.

eligibility.B.Tech: Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
eligibility.M.Tech: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Engineering.

exam.title: Examination Information
exam.semester_exams: Semester examinations are conducted twice every academic year.
exam.admit_card: Admit cards are released one week before the examination.
exam.attendance: Minimum 75% attendance is required to appear in examinations.
exam.results: Results are published on the university portal.
exam.backlog: Students with backlogs may appear in supplementary examinations.
exam.grading: Grades are awarded according to university regulations.

fees.title: Fee Structure
fees.refund_policy: Refunds are processed according to university regulations.
